channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: A estratégia do PT para conter danos com o segmento evangélico
item.description: The PT held an event with progressive pastors and released a document aimed at reducing resistance among Brazil’s evangelical electorate, which makes up 27% of the population and has increasingly aligned with the right. The strategy seeks to distance the party from the politicization of religion, criticizing figures like Silas Malafaia and associating right-wing leaders with the label 'merchants of faith', while emphasizing the PT’s presence in marginalized communities and shared social values with believers.

item.title: Crusoé: Censura de Nunes Marques é Direito Xandônico com sinal trocado
item.description: The Crusoé article, published on O Antagonista, criticizes the TSE's actions under Alexandre de Moraes during the 2022 elections, alleging selective censorship against content unfavorable to Lula, including blocking a Brasil Paralelo documentary about the stabbing of Bolsonaro. It claims this interference unfairly benefited Lula's candidacy.

item.title: Longe da liderança em Minas, Simões acha 'mais conveniente' Zema ser vice de Flávio ou não disputar o Planalto
item.description: Minas Gerais Governor Mateus Simões (PSD) said it would be more convenient for his re-election if Romeu Zema (Novo) did not run for president or ran as Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL) vice president, as it would avoid a runoff in the state. Simões took office after Zema's resignation but struggles in polls, ranking fourth with 4% voter intention, while Cleitinho (Republicanos) leads despite not confirming candidacy. He emphasized he cannot ask Zema to withdraw due to loyalty, as Zema had chosen him as successor.

item.title: Presidente do PT evita criticar decisão de Nunes Marques sobre pesquisa: ‘Deve ter fundamentos’
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva refrained from directly criticizing TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques' monocratic decision to suspend the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg electoral poll, stating the decision 'must have grounds' and that the PT respects judicial rulings. He emphasized Lula's re-election as the priority in regional alliances, even if it overrides local party interests. The seminar also launched a debate on judiciary reform focused on strengthening the CNJ, not necessarily to be included in Lula's government program.

item.title: Em carta aos evangélicos, PT condena ‘manipulação política’ da fé
item.description: The PT released a letter to evangelicals condemning the political and economic manipulation of faith, highlighting the spread of fake news and hate speech. The document was drafted at the 4th National Meeting of Evangelicals of the PT, attended by First Lady Janja da Silva, and emphasizes convergences between the party and the evangelical electorate, such as defending democracy, social justice, and policies like ending the 6×1 work schedule and combating hunger.

item.title: As ofensivas de Lula para tentar tirar ‘novo tarifaço’ da cabeça de Trump
item.description: President Lula is considering strategies to convince Trump to reverse the new tariff on Brazilian products, including a potential bilateral meeting during the G7 in Paris and mobilizing other affected countries to pressure the U.S. Ministers Mauro Vieira and Marcio Elias Rosa are already in talks with U.S. Trade Representative Jamieson Greer to assess the situation. The effort aims to prevent negative impacts on Brazilian exports and preserve bilateral trade balance.

item.title: Renato Casagrande lidera disputa ao Senado no ES, diz pesquisa
item.description: Renato Casagrande (PSB) leads the Senate race in Espírito Santo, according to a Real Time Big Data poll conducted June 6–8, 2026. Paulo Hartung (PSD) and Sérgio Meneguelli (PSD) are tied for the second seat. The survey interviewed 1,600 people, with a 2-point margin of error and TSE registration ES-06698/2026.

item.title: Lula tem 48% de imagem positiva e 48% de negativa em pesquisa da CB Global Data
item.description: The CB Global Data poll shows President Lula's image is split, with 47.6% positive and 48.1% negative ratings, reversing the favorable balance from May. Despite the slight decline, he remains sixth among Latin American leaders, in the upper half of the regional ranking. The situation reflects a polarized country, with domestic evaluations still tight and the public opinion battle ongoing.

item.title: Ingressos para a NFL no Rio começam a ser vendidos hoje: saiba como comprar
item.description: Tickets for the NFL Rio Game 2026, featuring the Dallas Cowboys vs. Baltimore Ravens at Maracanã, went on sale today, April 9, at 10 a.m. Brasília time, via Ticketmaster and the West Box Office at Estádio Nilton Santos. Prices range from R$247.50 (half-price) to R$2,720.00 (full price), with payment options including PIX, credit card in up to 10 interest-free installments (with a 10% fee), or cash/debit/card at the box office. The game will take place on September 27, a Sunday, at 5:25 p.m. Brasília time, marking the NFL’s first-ever game in Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Pesquisa Quaest testa Lula x Flávio após tarifaço de Trump: três pontos de atenção
item.description: The Genial/Quaest poll, scheduled for June 10, will test Lula against Flávio Bolsonaro following Trump’s tariffs and the Banco Master scandal. Recent surveys (AtlasIntel, Datafolha, BTG Nexus, Meio/Ideia, Real Time Big Data) show Lula expanding his lead, with 38% vs 31% in the first round and 45% vs 40% in the second, indicating Flávio’s declining support. The poll will determine whether this trend has solidified or if Flávio has stabilized, amid controversy over the TSE’s suspension of the AtlasIntel poll.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Nunes Marques terá teste em julgamento no TSE sobre pesquisa suspensa a pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Minister Nunes Marques suspended the AtlasIntel poll linking Flávio Bolsonaro to the Master scandal and Daniel Vorcaro, a move seen as a gesture to Bolsonarism and criticized as censorship by Abep and PT supporters. The TSE will today decide whether to uphold the injunction, testing Marques' support among peers and signaling whether the court intends to act as an electoral review instance.

item.title: Lula é o 6º presidente mais popular da América Latina em junho; veja o ranking
item.description: Lula ranks sixth in presidential popularity across Latin America, with 47.6% positive and 48.1% negative image, unchanged from May. The far-right regained the top spot with Nayib Bukele of El Salvador at 69.1% approval, followed by Claudia Sheinbaum of Mexico in second. The CB Consultora survey polled over 40,000 people across 17 countries between June 2 and 7.

item.title: A mensagem do PT aos eleitores evangélicos – cada vez mais distantes de Lula
item.description: The PT's evangelical nucleus released a statement supporting Lula's re-election, emphasizing popular policies such as ending the 6×1 work schedule and combating femicide, while rejecting the political instrumentalization of religion. The group avoids controversial topics like abortion and clarifies it does not speak for all denominations, but advocates for democracy, social justice, and the common good based on their faith.

item.title: Fiesp defende liberdade de escolha sobre escala de trabalho
item.description: On June 9, 2026, Fiesp and hundreds of business entities supported the Flexible Work PEC, which preserves labor rights like the 13th salary and paid vacation while allowing workers to choose their working hours. They criticized the PEC that mandates a 5-day workweek, arguing it ignores real-life needs such as caregiving, study, or income fluctuations, and advocated for individual flexibility over rigid schedules.

item.title: Código de Ética é resposta necessária e relatório será entregue a Fachin 'muito antes' do fim do ano, diz Cármen Lúcia
item.description: STF Minister Cármen Lúcia stated she is drafting a judicial ethics code and plans to deliver it to Minister Edson Fachin 'well before' the end of the year. She noted the work was paused due to her role at the TSE but has now resumed, aiming to increase transparency and public understanding of judicial conduct.

item.title: Caiado diz que Flávio Bolsonaro deve explicar ao Brasil elo com Daniel Vorcaro
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) stated that Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) must explain his connection to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of Banco Master imprisoned on billion-fraud charges, and that any candidate 'contaminated' by such associations lacks the moral authority to lead Brazil. Caiado also said Lula (PT) should clarify the alleged link between his son Lulinha and INSS discount scandals, framing the election as a 'vestibular' where voters choose candidates with the best credentials and moral authority.

item.title: 'As eleições no Brasil não serão um passeio no parque', diz executivo da OpenAI no país
item.description: Brazil's 2026 presidential elections will be the first with widespread use of AI, raising concerns about disinformation and bias, especially after the TSE approved specific rules. OpenAI hired Bruno Lewicki as director of public policy for Latin America to mitigate risks, while debate over the AI Framework and copyright intensifies criticism from journalists and experts about AI's impact on democracy and professional journalism.

item.title: Crença num Deus cabo eleitoral é perversão de valores cristãos
item.description: The article criticizes the use of religion as an electoral tool in Brazil, arguing that turning belief in God into a campaign operative perverts Christian values. It notes that despite Brazil facing serious issues like corruption, inequality, insecurity, and poor education, religion has been instrumentalized in electoral campaigns, creating artificial divisions and distorting public discourse. The author contends that faith should be personal and spiritual, not a instrument of partisan political mobilization.

item.title: Copa 2026: condomínio pode proibir bandeira do Brasil na janela ou sacada?
item.description: Condominiums may establish internal rules regarding the display of the Brazilian flag on balconies or windows, provided they respect constitutional freedom of expression and do not violate bylaws or municipal laws. The condo manager cannot arbitrarily prohibit it but may regulate size, timing, or manner of display for safety or aesthetic reasons. Any fines must be stipulated in the condominium convention and applied with due process.

item.title: Em livro, Moro critica decisão que beneficiou Flávio em caso de 'rachadinha': 'Temerária'
item.description: In his book 'Against the Corruption System', Sergio Moro harshly criticizes a judicial decision that benefited Flávio Bolsonaro in the 'rachadinhas' case, calling it 'reckless'. Despite their current electoral alliance in Paraná, Moro reveals historical divergences in their stances on fighting corruption. The 2021 publication discloses exclusive insights into internal conflicts among political allies.

item.title: PT divulga carta a evangélicos e diz que governos do partido 'nunca se opuseram às igrejas'
item.description: The PT released a letter to evangelicals defending President Lula's government, stating that PT administrations never opposed churches and always maintained a posture of respect and recognition. The document, released after the IV National Evangelical Meeting of the PT, highlights measures such as religious freedom guarantees, recognition of gospel music as cultural heritage, and establishment of national days linked to Christian faith. The initiative aims to broaden dialogue with the evangelical electorate, a growing segment where Lula faces greater approval challenges.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro lidera 2º turno no ES com 48%, diz pesquisa RealTime/Big Data; Lula tem 43%
item.description: A RealTime/Big Data poll shows Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading the presidential runoff in Espírito Santo with 48% of voting intentions, compared to 43% for President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT). Blank and null votes total 4%, while 5% of respondents were undecided or did not answer.

item.title: Comida cada vez mais cara é o novo problema eleitoral de Lula
item.description: The accelerated rise in food prices in São Paulo, with a 3.9% increase from January to May, is becoming a significant electoral challenge for President Lula during his 2026 re-election campaign. This food inflation, above the general average, directly affects 9.3 million voters in the country's fifth-largest electoral college, where polls indicate that cost of living and indebtedness are decisive factors for eight out of ten voters. Despite Lula's seven-point victory in São Paulo in 2022, the current scenario suggests no easy days ahead due to the combined effects of the Middle East war and the El Niño phenomenon, which are expected to maintain upward pressure on prices.

item.title: 52% desaprovam e 40% aprovam governo Lula, diz pesquisa Gerp
item.description: A Gerp poll shows 52% of Brazilians disapprove of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s government, compared to 40% approval. Overall, 45% rate the administration as 'bad/terrible', while 33% see it as 'excellent/good'. The survey, registered with the TSE, interviewed 2,000 voters from June 2 to 5, 2026, with a margin of error of 2.24 percentage points.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro vence Lula no 2º turno, diz pesquisa Gerp
item.description: A Gerp poll shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leading Lula in a hypothetical runoff with 44.7% to 39.1%, within the 2.58-point margin of error. In the first round, Bolsonaro has 35% and Lula 34%. Lula is the most rejected candidate at 48%, compared to Bolsonaro's 42%.

item.title: Lula é rejeitado por 48% e Flávio, por 42%, diz pesquisa Gerp
item.description: A Gerp poll released on June 9, 2026, shows 48% of voters reject President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), while 42% reject Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), the PL's pre-candidate for president. The survey, conducted June 2–5 with 2,000 respondents, has a 2.24 percentage point margin of error and 95.55% confidence level, registered with the TSE as BR-01792/2026. The question asked: 'Which of these candidates would you never vote for under any circumstances?'.

item.title: Congresso de Internet discute regulamentação e impacto de IA nas eleições
item.description: The 6th Brazilian Internet Congress is discussing AI regulation ahead of the 2026 elections, focusing on the TSE’s ban on unlabeled synthetic content 72 hours before and 24 hours after voting. Former TSE Minister Cármen Lúcia and current Minister Floriano Marques join officials from the Central Bank, CADE, Finance Ministry, and ANPD to debate innovation, legal security, and accountability. The TSE resolution imposes joint liability on digital platforms for failing to remove illegal synthetic content during the electoral period.

item.title: Tarcísio acelera repasses à saúde municipal em SP
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas announced a transfer of 801 million reais to the 645 municipalities of São Paulo to strengthen municipal health, with 201 million from the IGM SUS Paulista and 600 million in voluntary transfers from state deputies. The funds will be used for financing and investment in primary care, vaccination, family health, and arbovirus control. Additionally, the SUS Paulista Table was expanded for municipal hospitals, with 760 million reais annually allocated to approximately 100 hospitals in 77 cities, aiming to reduce financing gaps and improve access to consultations, exams, and surgeries.

item.title: Vovô-garoto: Ancelotti fica atrás de Scaloni e Deschamps em ranking dos técnicos mais atraentes da Copa
item.description: A study by Live Football Tickets ranked the coaches of the 2026 World Cup based on physical attractiveness, combining facial symmetry, height, age, and professional performance. Carlo Ancelotti, Brazil's coach, placed 27th with a score of 6.95, behind Lionel Scaloni (21st, 7.28) and Didier Deschamps (28th, 6.82). The top of the list was led by Vladimir Petkovic (Algeria, 9.3), followed by Tony Popovic (Australia) and Graham Potter (Sweden).

item.title: Governistas veem “tiro no pé” da campanha de Flávio com suspensão de pesquisa
item.description: Government lawmakers criticize Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) pre-campaign for requesting the suspension of the AtlasIntel/Bloomberg poll, which shows him down six points against Lula (PT) in a potential runoff. They call it a 'self-inflicted wound,' arguing it highlights electoral weakness and attempts to suppress unfavorable data. The move is seen as counterproductive, potentially damaging his image further among voters.

item.title: O dia decisivo de Alcolumbre sobre PEC do fim da escala 6×1
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre will hold a decisive meeting with party leaders on the PEC to end the 6×1 work scale, potentially appointing the rapporteur and setting the bill's timeline. Choosing a rapporteur aligned with the Presidency would signal a gesture to Lula, following months of strained relations. Alcolumbre is also expected to forward the Chamber-approved PEC to the Senate’s Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ), aligning its progress with an existing Senate proposal.

item.title: Câmara prevê que partidos quitem dívidas em parcelas 40% menores que a média cobrada de brasileiros endividados
item.description: The Chamber approved a bill allowing political parties to pay debts, including electoral fines, in installments of up to R$30,000 over 180 months (15 years), amounting to about R$166 monthly — 40% less than the average income commitment of indebted Brazilians (29.7%). The proposal also shortens judicial review periods, permits renegotiation of existing debts regardless of amount, and loosens accountability standards by treating revenue discrepancies under 10% as mere reservations. Critics argue the changes weaken electoral oversight and reduce accountability for misuse of public funds.

item.title: Assessores de Flávio Bolsonaro preveem 'ligeira queda' dele na nova Quaest
item.description: Advisors of Flávio Bolsonaro predict a 'slight decline' in his voting intention in the upcoming Quaest poll, set to be released tomorrow morning. Despite high expectations among political parties, the Quaest and Datafolha polls are regarded as the most serious benchmarks in political analysis. The full article is available only to subscribers.

item.title: O dia em que o delator Mauro Cid ficou frente a frente com Bolsonaro faz aniversário
item.description: Today, June 9, marks the one-year anniversary of the interrogation of former aide Mauro Cid before the Supreme Federal Court, in which he confirmed his prior statements about an alleged coup plot led by Jair Bolsonaro and his allies. The exclusive article highlights the direct confrontation between the informant and the former president during the testimony. The event is considered a landmark in investigations into the anti-democratic acts of January 8.

item.title: STF prepara terreno para atuação em eleições e desafia TSE liderado por Nunes Marques
item.description: STF ministers admit the court should play a more intense role in the 2026 elections, particularly to make 'eventual corrections' in electoral propaganda. The assessment was made by four justices interviewed by the column, who advocate for a more active intervention by the Supreme Court in the electoral process. The article is exclusive to subscribers.

item.title: Trecho de decisão de Kassio Nunes contra pesquisa deixa outros institutos em alerta
item.description: The decision by TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques to suspend the AtlasIntel poll showing declining voter intention for Flávio Bolsonaro sparked controversy. A specific passage in the ruling has put other polling institutes on alert, fearing it may set a precedent restricting the release of electoral data.

item.title: PT tenta conter crise com PSB após João Campos reagir à defesa de palanque duplo para Lula
item.description: The PSB objected after Minister Wellington Dias suggested Lula might support both João Campos (PSB) and Raquel Lyra (PSD) in Pernambuco, sparking tension between allied parties. PT President Edinho Silva distanced himself from the comment, reaffirming that Lula has only one electoral base in the state: João Campos. The incident raised concerns about potential repercussions for the PSB’s national support of the PT.

item.title: Gastança dos estados piora crise fiscal
item.description: In Brazil, election years have historically seen increased and irresponsible government spending, with President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva and state governors distributing electoral 'goodies'. The extra spending already contracted is estimated to impact public accounts by around 2% of GDP, with the federal government accounting for 0.9 percentage point, state governments for 0.6, and the remaining 0.5 representing spending outside fiscal targets.

item.title: Interesses do Brasil devem prevalecer sobre amizade com Trump
item.description: The author criticizes the press's focus on candidates' personal proximity to Donald Trump, arguing it distracts from an objective analysis of Brazil's national interests. Both the Bolsonaro family's unwavering loyalty and Lula's amicable relationship with Trump are seen as obstacles to a colder, more strategic evaluation of bilateral relations. The piece argues that Brazil's interests should prevail over personal affinities with foreign leaders.

item.title: Comissão da Câmara deve votar redução da maioridade penal para 16 anos e aumentar pressão sobre governo na segurança pública
item.description: The Chamber's Constitution and Justice Committee (CCJ) is set to vote on the admissibility of a PEC to reduce the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16 years, with a favorable report from rapporteur Coronel Assis (PL-MT). Originally proposed in 2015 by Gonzaga Patriota (PSB-PE), the measure has gained traction among right-wing sectors and is being promoted by presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ), intensifying pressure on the federal government, which has historically opposed such a change.

item.title: TSE deve julgar nesta terça decisão de Nunes Marques que suspendeu pesquisa com queda de Flávio
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will rule on Tuesday (9) whether to uphold Minister Kassio Nunes Marques’ individual decision to suspend an AtlasIntel poll showing a five-point drop in Flávio Bolsonaro’s voting intentions. The poll was released after an audio leak revealed Bolsonaro asking banker Daniel Vorcaro for funds for a film about Jair Bolsonaro. AtlasIntel complied with the order but affirmed confidence in the poll’s technical robustness and legality.

item.title: TSE analisa decisão de Nunes Marques que alegou 'indução de entrevistados' e suspendeu pesquisa após pedido de Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The TSE is reviewing President Kássio Nunes Marques' decision to suspend the AtlasIntel poll over alleged inducement of respondents, following a request from Flávio Bolsonaro's defense. The measure is likely to be upheld, with the plenary viewing it as a preview of the Court's electoral oversight in 2026. Other polls, including Quaest and Datafolha, have also shown electoral wear for the senator.

item.title: Caiado minimiza caso “Dark Horse” e o compara a suspeitas sobre Lulinha
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado downplayed the leaked audio in which Flávio Bolsonaro requested money from Daniel Vorcaro to finance the film 'Dark Horse', stating such incidents will arise during the campaign and that it is up to the senator to explain his financial ties. He compared the situation to Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva’s failure to explain alleged frauds involving his son, Lulinha, in the INSS, saying the president has yet to clarify the matter.

item.title: Evangélicos são diversos e não há única posição entre cristãos, diz PT
item.description: The PT held its 4th National Evangelicals Meeting in Brasília, presenting a political letter emphasizing the diversity of the evangelical electorate and rejecting the idea of a single political voice within the segment. The document defends democracy, social justice, secular state, and religious freedom, while seeking rapprochement with evangelicals amid a 60% disapproval rate of Lula’s government according to PoderData. It includes proposals for women’s health, family farming, youth, people with disabilities, and access to justice for Black Brazilians.

item.title: Governo vai flexibilizar regra de fundo voltado à inovação para liberar crédito ao agro
item.description: The Lula government plans to relax the application rules of the FNDCT to unlock a credit line for agricultural machinery purchases, announced in April by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, which has not yet been launched due to bureaucratic constraints.

item.title: Eleição em MG desafia Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro, e campanhas procuram candidatos a governador
item.description: Minas Gerais has become the main battleground for the PT and PL coalitions in the 2026 elections, as both seek to build strong state-level slates to support Lula’s re-election bid and Flávio Bolsonaro’s presidential campaign. The state, decisive for the national outcome, is seeing campaigns intensify their search for gubernatorial candidates capable of forging local and national alliances.

item.title: Com versículos bíblicos e pauta eleitoral, PT lança carta aos evangélicos para 2026
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) released an open letter addressed to Brazilian evangelical voters, signed by the IV National Meeting of Evangelicals of the party. The document blends biblical verses with government proposals, defends Lula's re-election in 2026, and criticizes the instrumentalization of religion in politics. Aimed at winning over a historically resistant electorate, the letter highlights social policies, racial justice, environmental protection, and programs such as Bolsa Família and income tax exemption for those earning up to R$ 5,000.

item.title: Caiado usa termo “judiar” para dizer que o PT prejudica o país
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), a pre-candidate for President, claimed the PT 'judiou' the population, using a term considered pejorative and discriminatory due to its historical association with Jewish suffering. He accused the party of impoverishing, indebting, and inciting violence, citing 90 million indebted Brazilians and crisis across all sectors. The expression had previously been used by Lula in other contexts but was later retracted following backlash.

item.title: Brasil passa por “mexicanização”, diz Caiado sobre poder das facções
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) warned that Brazil is undergoing a 'Mexicanization' of politics, with criminal factions like PCC and CV infiltrating the formal economy and political power through corruption, candidate financing, and violence. He pledged that if elected, he would designate PCC and CV as foreign terrorist organizations on his first day in office, January 5, 2027, to 'rescue Brazil'.

item.title: TSE vai analisar nesta terça-feira decisão de Kassio Nunes sobre pesquisa AtlasIntel
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) will analyze on Tuesday (June 9) the decision by Minister Kassio Nunes Marques that suspended the dissemination of the AtlasIntel poll on presidential voting intentions. The injunction was requested by pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), who claimed the inclusion of audio from his conversation with Daniel Vorcaro compromised the questionnaire’s methodological neutrality. AtlasIntel states the audio was played only after voting intention responses were collected, but the TSE will decide whether to uphold or overturn the injunction.
